title: Driver Pay Schedule 3: Driver Shares of Rider Fees and Tips
content:
Some charges a rider pays are shared with the driver under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**. This schedule sets the driver's share of each such charge. The shares are the same at every Wayfare Pro status: Wayfare Pro Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite.

| Rider charge | Driver's share (every status) |
|---|---|
| Rider cancellation fee | 80% |
| Rider no-show fee | 80% |
| Rider tip | 100% |
| Cleaning fee charged to a rider | 100% |
| Damage fee charged to a rider | 100% |

## Hypothetical share readings

| Hypothetical rider charge | Driver's share |
|---|---|
| Cancellation fee of 5.00 | 4.00 |
| No-show fee of 7.50 | 6.00 |
| Tip of 6.00 | 6.00 |
| Cleaning fee of 80.00 | 80.00 |
| Damage fee of 250.00 | 250.00 |

Each share is a percentage of the amount the rider was charged, rounded half up to the cent.
